class LRUCache:

    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.get(1)       # returns 1
    cache.put(3, 3)    # evicts key 2
    cache.get(2)       # returns -1 (not found)

test_code:
from solution import LRUCache


def test_basic_usage():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    assert cache.get(1) == 1
    cache.put(3, 3)
    assert cache.get(2) == -1


def test_get_refreshes_order():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.get(1)       # 1 is now most recently used
    cache.put(3, 3)    # should evict 2, not 1
    assert cache.get(1) == 1
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(3) == 3


def test_update_existing_key():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(1, 10)   # update key 1
    assert cache.get(1) == 10
    cache.put(3, 3)    # should evict 2 (1 was refreshed by put)
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == 10


def test_capacity_one():
    cache = LRUCache(1)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    assert cache.get(1) == 1
    cache.put(2, 2)
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == 2


def test_get_missing_key():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    assert cache.get(999) == -1


def test_put_then_evict_chain():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(3, 3)    # evicts 1
    cache.put(4, 4)    # evicts 2
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(3) == 3
    assert cache.get(4) == 4


def test_overwrite_does_not_change_size():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(1, 100)  # overwrite, no eviction
    cache.put(2, 200)  # overwrite, no eviction
    assert cache.get(1) == 100
    assert cache.get(2) == 200


def test_eviction_after_get_refresh():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(3, 3)
    cache.get(1)       # refresh key 1
    cache.get(2)       # refresh key 2
    cache.put(4, 4)    # should evict 3 (least recently used)
    assert cache.get(3) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == 1
    assert cache.get(2) == 2
    assert cache.get(4) == 4


def test_rapid_overwrite_same_key():
    cache = LRUCache(1)
    for i in range(100):
        cache.put(1, i)
    assert cache.get(1) == 99


def test_interleaved_get_put():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(2, 1)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 3)    # refresh key 2
    cache.put(4, 1)    # evicts key 1
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == 3

def count_overlaps(ranges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> int:
    """Count number of overlapping pairs in a list of (start, end) ranges.
    Two ranges overlap if they share any interior point.

    count_overlaps([(1,5),(2,6),(8,10)]) == 1  # only (1,5) and (2,6) overlap
    count_overlaps([(1,3),(2,4),(3,5)]) == 2  # (1,3)&(2,4), (2,4)&(3,5)
    count_overlaps([]) == 0
    """
